evidence.title: Deploy an Open Model from Checkpoint to Inference in Two Commands with NVIDIA TensorRT Model Connect

summary: NVIDIA's new TensorRT Model Connect tool lets developers deploy open‑source AI models with just two commands, streamlining the transition from training checkpoints to production inference. The solution integrates with NVIDIA's TensorRT runtime to accelerate deployment on GPU‑accelerated hardware.
title: NVIDIA introduces TensorRT Model Connect, enabling two‑command deployment from checkpoint to inference
